summary: First full run. Backend: 20/20 pytest pass (new tests/test_adzen_api.py + existing retell webhook test) covering lead intake (quote/contact/systems_check), idempotency (same ref + duplicate:true, one DB record), elapsed_ms guard, branch validation, auth 401/403/200 with real Clerk session tokens, admin list/filters/overdue/search, PATCH stage/next_action/follow_up/booking, notes, conversations, manual phone/whatsapp leads, link contacts, CSV, reports totals, integrations, voice web-call 400/503, hidden case studies, sitemap/robots. Email outbox reached 'sent' to delivered@resend.dev; Formspree 'disabled'. Frontend (Playwright desktop 1920x800 + mobile 390x800): Quote wizard end-to-end incl. branching (automation/portal questions), validation keeping values, reload persistence, optional timing/budget, Edit jumps, route-abort failure banner + retry success, reference AZM-YYMMDD-XXXX; offer page CTAs preselect service; /contact short form + validation; systems check result -> quote prefill + optional contact lead; SEO title/description/canonical/noindex on 14 routes; draft case study redirect; founder dashboard via Clerk ticket (table, filters, search, manual inquiry, lead detail stage/follow-up/note/booking/WhatsApp log persisted after reload, reports, system page); member sees Access restricted; sign-out works. Core everything works; found 2 medium UI bugs and a few minor ones.

minor.issue: Emergent email proxy returned 429 rate_limited after a burst of ~6 leads; jobs go to 'retrying' with 30s*2^n backoff and become permanently 'failed' after 5 attempts (~7.5 min). 429 should use longer backoff / Retry-After and not count toward MAX_ATTEMPTS so founder notifications are not lost (founder can retry manually via email-retry-btn).
validate_lead accepts partial check_answers (any subset of valid keys) – only checks values are valid, not that all 5 questions are answered (the /public/systems-check endpoint does require all).
Uses blocking requests.get inside async dependency (first-login only) – blocks event loop up to 10s; use httpx.AsyncClient.

ui_bugs.issue: Hamburger menu toggle overflows viewport: document scrollWidth=424 on every public page; nav-menu-toggle right edge at 424px, so the menu button is cut off/off-screen and page scrolls horizontally. Logo + 'Contact' + 'Request a quote' + toggle don't fit. Hide nav-contact-mobile below ~420px or shrink CTA.

If sessionStorage azm_quote already holds a service (wizard previously started), clicking an offer page 'Request a quote' (/quote?service=website) keeps the OLD service (e.g. training) because the effect only applies svc when !p.service. Same for systems-check 'Turn this into a quote request' (service and goal ignored if goal already set). Explicit ?service param should override (maybe clear service-specific answers).
No client-side validation; submitting empty shows raw Pydantic messages 'Field required' x3 instead of friendly text (Quote wizard/contact form show 'Please enter your name' etc.).
Systems-check confirmation copy says 'This is a request for a scoped quote: no price, delivery date...' – quote-specific text shown for systems check result submissions.
After submit (wizard/systems check) the page is not scrolled to the confirmation; its heading sits under the sticky header on desktop.

issues: Follow-up date uses native <input type=date> (browser picker) instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover
Headline shows 'Whatsapp:' (should be 'WhatsApp:') for manual whatsapp leads (CHANNEL_LABELS capitalize())
No loading state: shows '0 shown' with empty table before leads arrive (observed once right after sign-in)
Bare page with no link back to site / sign-out text, top-left aligned
No meta description; canonical points to the non-existent URL

action_items: Fix mobile header overflow at 390px so nav-menu-toggle is visible (scrollWidth must equal 390)
Make ?service= (and from=check) override a previously stored wizard service in QuoteWizard
Add client-side validation + friendly messages to systems-check contact form
Treat email 429 with longer backoff/Retry-After, not as an attempt toward permanent failure
Require all 5 check_answers in validate_lead for systems_check channel
Minor copy/design: systems-check confirmation text, 'WhatsApp' casing, shadcn date picker, dashboard loading state
critical_code_review_comments: QuoteWizard.jsx L41-45: `if (svc && !p.service)` ignores explicit URL intent when sessionStorage has state
SystemsCheck.jsx SendResult: no client validation; errorMap shows backend 'Field required'
notify.py _process: 429 counted toward MAX_ATTEMPTS=5 with max ~4 min delay
leads.py validate_lead systems_check: partial answers accepted
auth_admin.py _clerk_user sync requests in async path
admin.py DELETE /api/admin/samples exists (bulk delete) – not executed by tester; needs manual check

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows work; mobile header overflow + stale service preselect bugs)

test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md: founder+clerk_test@example.com (admin), member+clerk_test@example.com (member). Session tokens via Clerk Backend API; POST /v1/sessions/{id}/tokens needs JSON body {} (else 415).
seed_data_creation: None. All TEST_ leads created (API + UI) were deleted by id/reference afterwards; sample leads untouched. DB now has 4 samples + 1 pre-existing lead.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests -q` (xdist -n 2 configured). test_adzen_api.py reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env and CLERK_SECRET_KEY via dotenv (never printed). UI sign-in: python script POST /v1/sign_in_tokens then open /sign-in?__clerk_ticket=<token> (one-time use). Email proxy rate limits bursts (429) – expect some 'retrying' outbox jobs after many submissions. Retest: mobile header scrollWidth at 390px, offer CTA after a prior wizard session, systems-check contact validation.
